title: Athelney, Ruwa (Harare East)
summary: Fully serviced residential stands ready for title: tarred roads, storm water drains, sewer and water. Prices depend on the size of the stand, with a 10-year mortgage facility.

details.label: Price
details.value: US$60.00/m² for stands up to 650 m²; US$55.00/m² for 651 to 1,000 m²; US$45.00/m² above 1,000 m² (before VAT)

details.label: Terms of sale
details.value: 10-year mortgage with 12% interest per annum and 10% deposit; or 10% deposit, balance over 36 months at 12% interest per annum

details.label: Services
details.value: Tarred roads, storm water drains, sewer and water
